summary: iter198+iter197 frontend e2e testing. All 6 requested user flows PASS. Real OSM Nominatim + OSRM routing works from configured office (23.1136,-82.3666) to 'Calle 23 Vedado La Habana' returning 4.4 km and 2.2 USDT (min-fee floor of 2). Admin TOTP-gated courier-fee apply on cash withdrawals AND redemptions both work and refund on km=0. Settings persist through reload. email-health-ok banner shows 7-day counters.
critical_code_review_comments: services/courier_fee.py implements MAX(min_fee, km*rate) with free-min override cleanly; shared by marketplace redemption and cash withdrawal paths.
Nominatim+OSRM calls are proxied through backend (orders.py geo-search + courier-route-quote) - avoids CORS and hides client IP from public OSM. Good pattern.
CourierQuotePicker UX handles all three states with correct data-testid: courier-quote-result (normal), courier-quote-free (>=1000 USDT equiv), courier-quote-manual (OSM failure fallback).

Admin apply-fee endpoints require TOTP step-up (both /api/admin/withdrawals/{id}/courier-fee and /api/admin/redemptions/{id}/courier-fee). km=0 correctly refunds previously charged fee (verified: CUP 498480 -> 500000).

Nit: AdminOverview save-threshold-btn now saves several unrelated settings groups (VIP threshold + courier + office coords + ops emails + provinces). Consider renaming or splitting per-section save buttons.
Nit: GET /api/admin/withdrawals/{id} returns 404 (route not defined). UI reads from list endpoint so unaffected, but external tools would fail on per-id lookup.
